reasons: Both answers correctly explain ст. 220, the 2 млн and 3 млн limits, and that the refund depends on НДФЛ actually paid. B drops an English phrase ('recalled, not verified') into the Russian text and wrongly says the deduction is available 'один раз в жизни', although the post-2014 purchase deduction can be spread across several properties. A states the rules more precisely, including that the 2 млн limit can be carried over to another object.

B: Says the property deduction can be obtained only once in a lifetime; since 2014 the purchase deduction's 2 млн limit can be used across several properties (only the interest deduction is limited to one object).
